description: This Java source file defines the package-private interface 'MongoHints' used for configuring MongoDB query hints within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested classes for handling empty hints and namespace-specific hints derived from JSON input, facilitating optional and flexible hint retrieval based on namespace filters.

classes.name: MongoHints
classes.description: Package-private interface for configuring MongoDB hints, providing methods to retrieve hints and static factory methods to create hint instances.

classes.name: MongoHints.Empty
classes.description: Implementation of MongoHints representing no hints, always returning an empty Optional.

classes.name: MongoHints.ByNamespace
classes.description: Implementation of MongoHints that extracts a map of namespace hints from a JSON string and provides hints based on a set of namespaces, with logic to parse and convert hints to Bson.

methods.name: getHint
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Bson hint for the provided set of namespaces, if any matches exist.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an instance of MongoHints that always returns no hints.

methods.name: byNamespace
methods.description: Creates an instance of MongoHints based on a JSON string mapping namespaces to hints.
